Title: Mark cash received has no status guard and is not idempotent; revives cancelled orders to PAID
Steps: POST cash-received twice; and on a cancelled order
Expected: Second call rejected; cancelled order refuses cash
Actual: Reproduced: cash on CANCELLED revived to CONFIRMED/PAID; 2nd call returned 200 and re-notified. quantitySold not double-incremented for single listing order (held>=qty guard); rate-plan cross-hold path not reproduced
Suggested fix: Guard on SUBMITTED+UNPAID; single conditional update; disable button

Title: Guest checkout overwrites an existing account holders name and attaches the order
Steps: Guest order with contact.phone = a real customers phone; log in as them
Expected: Guest cannot modify a registered account
Actual: Reproduced: guest order with the accounts phone changed name Anas->qa_test_OVERWRITE and attached the order to /me/orders
Suggested fix: Only $setOnInsert identity; match signed-in by session only

Title: Payment notify webhook unsigned and settlement verifies no amount/currency
Steps: Pay a cheap order; POST notify with expensive reference + cheap PmtID
Expected: Signature verified and amount/currency compared before PAID
Actual: No signature; no amount check; call-status read as payment-status
Suggested fix: Verify signature; re-fetch and compare amount+currency+reference

Title: Live MongoDB credentials committed to backend repo
Steps: git log -p the file
Actual: Full mongodb+srv URI with user/pass in git history
Suggested fix: Rotate now; move to env; purge history

Title: Android release keystore and passwords committed to mobile repo
Steps: Inspect repo / .gitignore
Actual: keystore.properties and FlexiAgency.keystore tracked
Suggested fix: Rotate key; remove from history; gitignore

Title: Every error response leaks a full stack trace and absolute paths (and Mongo cluster internals)
Steps: curl /auth/me with a bad Bearer; curl admin /customers?q=[
Actual: Bodies include stack with server paths; admin regex leaks Mongo $clusterTime/signature
Suggested fix: Set NODE_ENV=production; strip stack/raw driver errors

Title: Admin search ?q= is an unescaped $regex: 500 ReDoS and Mongo internals leaked
Steps: curl admin /customers?q=[ ; /locations?q=(
Actual: 500 Location51091 with cluster signature; ReDoS with (a+)+
Suggested fix: Escape before new RegExp; cap length

Title: Orders accept reversed past and invalid dates (no server-side date validation)
Steps: POST order with endDate<startDate or 2020 dates or not-a-date
Actual: Dates pass validation+pricing; fail only at stock hold (line 305)
Suggested fix: Validate start>=today end>start max length and real dates

Title: Idempotency-Key is client-chosen and global not scoped to the caller
Steps: Create order with key K; replay K from another caller
Expected: Replay returns original to original caller only
Actual: Reproduced: signed-in customer replaying a guests key K got the guests order back (same reference)
Suggested fix: Namespace key by customer/session or body hash

Title: Admin create/update spreads req.body (mass assignment)
Steps: POST /admin/v1/listings with status quantitySold vertical slug rating
Actual: ...req.body lets a writer force PUBLISHED change counters vertical slug; reproduced: quantitySold forged to 777 and vertical flipped to HOTEL
Suggested fix: Explicit allowed fields; keep status/counters/slug server-side

Title: Open redirect after login via unchecked ?next
Steps: Visit /login?next=https://example.com then sign in
Actual: next pushed unchecked; off-site redirect after auth
Suggested fix: Accept next only if starts with single / and not //

Title: Passport/ID numbers entered at checkout are silently dropped
Steps: Book a flight entering a passport number; inspect order
Actual: Field name documentNumberMasked vs server documentNumber; strict mode drops it
Suggested fix: Send documentNumber/documentType; server-require for flights

Title: Settings accept negative/zero values with no bounds
Steps: Step-up then PATCH settings holdTtlCashHours:-5 or passportRetentionDays:-1; or clear a field in UI
Actual: Persists negatives/zeros; passportRetentionDays<=0 purges all passport data; empty UI saves 0
Suggested fix: Add min/max in schema+controller; empty UI = unchanged

Title: Order contact/traveller fields not validated server-side
Steps: POST order with bad email 5000-char name future DOB object/array traveller names
Actual: Passes validation+pricing (reaches stock check); would store junk; enc:v1 bypass
Suggested fix: Validate email lengths DOB and that names are strings

Title: Enquiry endpoint accepts invalid email and unbounded name
Steps: POST enquiry with 10k name and not-an-email
Actual: 201 created with 10k name and bogus email
Suggested fix: Validate email; cap name/label length

Title: Customer logout does not revoke the bearer token
Steps: Capture token; logout; reuse token on /auth/me
Actual: Only cookie cleared; bearer valid up to 7 days renewable to 90
Suggested fix: Track tokensValidFrom and bump on logout

Title: Customer phone not unique duplicate accounts
Steps: Concurrent sign-ups/guest upserts for one phone
Actual: Duplicate rows; login picks arbitrary one
Suggested fix: Unique index on phone

Title: notifications/test sends SMS to any number returns raw Twilio error
Steps: POST /admin/v1/notifications/test to any number
Actual: Any notifications:write holder SMS arbitrary text to any number; no double-submit guard
Suggested fix: Restrict to verified numbers; validate E.164; rate limit

Title: OTP lockout resets on resend; attempt count check-then-increment
Steps: Exhaust attempts; resend; attempts reset to 0
Expected: Attempt cap per phone across resends
Actual: Resend zeroes attempts; parallel guesses exceed 5
Suggested fix: Per-phone atomic counter; dont reset on resend

Title: Placeholder phone numbers and a fictional agent are live on customer pages
Steps: Open /property/listing/terrain-de-2-019-m-ville-basse-matadi-5
Actual: Fictional agent Joseph Mukendi and +243 81 000 00 00 shown to customers
Suggested fix: Pull from settings; hide when no real contact

Title: Horizontal overflow at 360px on 7 pages
Steps: Load each at 360x740
Actual: scrollWidth>clientWidth on contact login and 5 account pages
Suggested fix: Constrain fixed-width children; audit paddings at 360px

Title: Property (enquiry-only) bookable through flight/bus/car/activity routes
Steps: Open /flights/offer/<property-slug>
Actual: Property renders on flight template; duplicate SEO (pricing rejects PROPERTY server-side)
Suggested fix: Verify listing.vertical matches route else 404

Title: Restaurant and social-preview images broken (mediaUrl bypass/doubled origin)
Steps: Load restaurant pages; inspect img src and og:image
Actual: Raw /uploads from frontend host 404; OG becomes https://domainhttps://...
Suggested fix: Route via mediaUrl; dont prefix absolute URLs

Title: Seed catalogue has zero bookable inventory; checkout cannot complete
Steps: GET admin /listings?limit=100; POST any order
Actual: All listings sold out/held; every order 409 That just sold out
Suggested fix: Reseed with stock or expose QA reset; check hold leaks

Title: Admin state-changing actions lack confirms/double-submit guards; step-up double-Enter fires twice
Steps: Double-Enter in password dialog; double-click publish/transition
Actual: Double Enter runs action twice; many buttons no busy/confirm
Suggested fix: Disable confirm while busy; add confirms; send version

Title: Mobile expired session still shows signed-in; prev users data cached after sign-out
Steps: Let session expire or sign out then sign in as another user within 60s
Actual: customer never reset; react-query cache not cleared; second user sees first users orders
Suggested fix: Reset customer on SESSION_INVALID; queryClient.clear on sign-out

Title: html lang always fr regardless of selected language
Steps: Load /about; read html lang
Actual: html lang=fr always; only updated on manual switch
Suggested fix: Set lang from resolved locale on load

Title: Account lists show empty during loading and on API error
Steps: Open account while loading or with API down
Actual: isPending/isError ignored; shows empty
Suggested fix: Render loading and error states

Title: Leftover pages/api/hello boilerplate in web and admin
Steps: GET /api/hello
Actual: Returns {name:John Doe}
Suggested fix: Delete

Title: JWT errors map to HTTP 404 in the global error handler
Steps: Force a JWT error reaching the handler
Actual: handleJWTError returns 404 (auth middleware returns 401 first)
Suggested fix: Map JsonWebTokenError to 401
